"""Compatibility detection: canonical invocation schema & validation rules.

Phase 1 / Area 1.A detection suite.  Every test fabricates an input, mutates
exactly one field, and asserts the real validator's rejection (or documents the
actual behavior when it differs from the plan).  No provider subprocess is
launched and no harness source module is modified.

The canonical baseline is copied verbatim from ``test_s2_contract._canonical``
so the two suites share the exact fixture shape.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from orchestrator_harness.invocation import (
    CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
    CanonicalInvocation,
    InvocationValidationError,
    _digest,
    _strings,
    adapt_coding_v1,
    adapt_invocation,
    parse_canonical_invocation,
)
import orchestrator_harness.lane_controller as controller
from orchestrator_harness.lane_controller import (
    InvocationError,
    _canonical_resume_admission_path,
    _canonical_resume_claims_accepted,
    _classify_provider_operations,
    _persist_canonical_acceptance,
    _provider_handoff_identity,
    _read_canonical_prior_status,
    _reject_ambiguous_coding_aliases,
    _validate_canonical_output_paths,
    isolated_coding_child_environment,
    load_invocation,
)
from orchestrator_harness.profile import RuntimeProfile
from orchestrator_harness.prompt_bundle import (
    PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA,
    prompt_bundle_record_from_paths,
)
from orchestrator_harness.task import TASK_CARD_SCHEMA, record_sha256

CODING_INVOCATION_SCHEMA = "orchestrator-coding-invocation/v1"


class CompatInvocationRulesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _canonical(self, root: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object], object]:
        """One valid ``orchestrator-worker-invocation/v1`` baseline (s2-identical)."""
        run = root / "run"
        workspace = run / ".agent-workspace"
        workspace.mkdir(parents=True)
        runtime = root / "runtime"
        runtime.mkdir()
        prompt_a = run / "prompt-a.md"
        prompt_b = run / "prompt-b.md"
        prompt_a.write_bytes(b"workflow\n")
        prompt_b.write_bytes(b"task\n")
        card = {
            "schema": TASK_CARD_SCHEMA,
            "card_id": "card-1",
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "stage_cohort_id": "cohort-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "objective": "Do the bounded task",
            "revision": "r1",
        }
        profile = RuntimeProfile(
            "profile-1",
            "implementer",
            "claude-code",
            "claude-test",
            ("Read",),
            ("repo",),
            ("resource-1",),
            ("CLAUDE_CODE_TEST",),
            ("WORKFLOW_TEST_FLAG",),
        )
        bundle = prompt_bundle_record_from_paths(
            workflow_id="workflow-1",
            task_card_id="card-1",
            profile_id="profile-1",
            paths=(("instructions", prompt_a), ("task", prompt_b)),
            run_root=run,
        )
        value: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema": CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
            "action": "start",
            "run_root": str(run),
            "runtime_root": str(runtime),
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "cohort_id": "cohort-1",
            "workflow": {"id": "workflow-1", "version": "1"},
            "task_card": {
                "id": "card-1",
                "revision": "r1",
                "sha256": record_sha256(card),
            },
            "role": "implementer",
            "provider": {
                "id": "claude-code",
                "model": "claude-test",
                "command": ["synthetic-claude"],
                "permission_mode": "default",
                "allowed_tools": ["Read"],
            },
            "profile": profile.to_record(),
            "prompt_bundle": bundle,
            "output_paths": {
                "status": str(workspace / "worker_controller.status.json"),
                "jsonl": str(workspace / "worker_provider.jsonl"),
                "stderr": str(workspace / "worker.stderr.log"),
                "last_message": str(workspace / "worker.last-message"),
            },
            "event_log_path": str(runtime / "events.jsonl"),
            "resources": ["resource-1"],
        }
        return value, card

    def _coding_v1_record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        """One valid ``orchestrator-coding-invocation/v1`` baseline (s2-identical)."""
        return {
            "schema": CODING_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
            "action": "start",
            "run_root": "C:/run",
            "runtime_root": "C:/runtime",
            "prompt_path": "C:/run/prompt.md",
            "prompt_sha256": "a" * 64,
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "task": "coding-task",
            "phase": "implementation",
            "event_log_path": "C:/runtime/events.jsonl",
            "output_paths": {
                "status": "C:/run/.agent-workspace/status.json",
                "jsonl": "C:/run/.agent-workspace/provider.jsonl",
                "stderr": "C:/run/.agent-workspace/stderr.log",
                "last_message": "C:/run/.agent-workspace/last-message",
            },
            "codex": {
                "model": "codex-test",
                "reasoning_effort": "medium",
                "service_tier": "priority",
                "sandbox": "workspace-write",
                "approval_policy": "never",
            },
        }

    # C2 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c2_action_must_be_start_or_resume(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            bad = dict(raw)
            bad["action"] = "foo"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationValidationError, "action"):
                parse_canonical_invocation(bad)
            start = parse_canonical_invocation(raw)
            self.assertEqual("start", start.action)
            resume = dict(raw)
            resume["action"] = "resume"
            resume["resume"] = {"session_id": "session-1"}
            parsed_resume = parse_canonical_invocation(resume)
            self.assertEqual("resume", parsed_resume.action)
            self.assertEqual("session-1", parsed_resume.requested_session_id)

    # C3 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c3_resume_requires_non_empty_session_id(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            missing = dict(raw)
            missing["action"] = "resume"
            with self.assertRaises(InvocationValidationError):
                parse_canonical_invocation(missing)
            empty = dict(raw)
            empty["action"] = "resume"
            empty["resume"] = {"session_id": ""}
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "session_id"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(empty)

    # C4 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c4_start_cannot_carry_resume_block(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            raw["resume"] = {"session_id": "session-1"}
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "cannot contain resume"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(raw)

    # C5 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c5_provider_notification_must_be_boolean(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            bad = dict(raw)
            bad["provider"] = {
                **raw["provider"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                "notification": "yes",
            }
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "notification"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(bad)
            for value in (True, False):
                ok = dict(raw)
                ok["provider"] = {
                    **raw["provider"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    "notification": value,
                }
                parsed = parse_canonical_invocation(ok)
                self.assertIn("notification", parsed.provider_options)

    # C6 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c6_profile_role_must_match_invocation_role(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            profile = dict(raw["profile"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            profile["role"] = "reviewer"
            raw["profile"] = profile
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "profile.role"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(raw)

    # C7 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c7_profile_provider_must_match_provider_id(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            profile = dict(raw["profile"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            profile["provider"] = "codex"
            raw["profile"] = profile
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "profile.provider"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(raw)

    # C8 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c8_profile_model_must_match_provider_model(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            profile = dict(raw["profile"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            profile["model"] = "different-model"
            raw["profile"] = profile
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "profile.model"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(raw)

    # C9 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c9_prompt_bundle_schema_and_version_validation(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            self.assertEqual(PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA, raw["prompt_bundle"]["schema"])  # type: ignore[index]
            wrong_schema = dict(raw)
            bundle = dict(raw["prompt_bundle"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            bundle["schema"] = "bogus-bundle/v1"
            wrong_schema["prompt_bundle"] = bundle
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "schema/version"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(wrong_schema)
            wrong_version = dict(raw)
            bundle = dict(raw["prompt_bundle"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            bundle["version"] = 2
            wrong_version["prompt_bundle"] = bundle
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "schema/version"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(wrong_version)

    # C10 --------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c10_resume_identity_must_be_an_object(self) -> None:
        # Coding-v1 exposes the field literally named "resume_identity".
        bad = self._coding_v1_record()
        bad["resume_identity"] = "not-an-object"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
            InvocationValidationError, "resume_identity"
        ):
            adapt_coding_v1(bad)
        ok = self._coding_v1_record()
        ok["resume_identity"] = {
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "thread_id": "thread-1",
        }
        adapted = adapt_coding_v1(ok)
        self.assertEqual("thread-1", adapted.requested_session_id)
        # The canonical route shares the object guard via the resume block.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            raw["action"] = "resume"
            raw["resume"] = "not-an-object"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "resume.*object"
            ):
                parse_canonical_invocation(raw)

    # C11 --------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c11_unknown_invocation_schema_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
            InvocationValidationError, "unsupported invocation schema"
        ):
            adapt_invocation({"schema": "bogus/v1"})
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            path = root / "bogus.invocation.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "bogus/v1"}), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationError, "unsupported invocation schema"
            ):
                load_invocation(path)

    # C16 --------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c16_ambiguous_coding_aliases_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationError, "ambiguous"):
            _reject_ambiguous_coding_aliases(
                {"codex": {}, "codex_settings": {}}
            )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationError, "ambiguous"):
            _reject_ambiguous_coding_aliases(
                {"resume_identity": {}, "resume": {}}
            )
        _reject_ambiguous_coding_aliases({"codex": {}})
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            coding = self._coding_v1_record()
            coding["codex_settings"] = dict(coding["codex"])  # type: ignore[index]
            path = root / "ambiguous.invocation.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps(coding), encoding="utf-8")

                load_invocation(path)

    # C18 --------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c18_canonical_output_path_safety_and_uniqueness(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            start_path = root / "start.invocation.json"
            start_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
            invocation = load_invocation(start_path)
            outputs = {
                "status": invocation.status_path,
                "jsonl": invocation.jsonl_path,
                "stderr": invocation.stderr_path,
                "last_message": invocation.last_message_path,
            }
            # Unique safe paths are accepted.
            _validate_canonical_output_paths(
                outputs, workspace=invocation.workspace
            )
            # Duplicate output paths are rejected.
            duplicated = dict(outputs)
            duplicated["jsonl"] = duplicated["status"]
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                InvocationValidationError, "pairwise distinct"
            ):
                _validate_canonical_output_paths(
                    duplicated, workspace=invocation.workspace
                )
            # A ``../`` traversal output path is rejected at load time: the
            # traversal guard lives in ``_safe_path``/``_load_canonical_invocation``
            # rather than in ``_validate_canonical_output_paths`` (which handles
            # pairwise uniqueness and reserved-artifact collisions only).
            traversal = json.loads(json.dumps(raw))
            output_paths = dict(traversal["output_paths"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            output_paths["jsonl"] = str(
                root / "run" / ".agent-workspace" / ".." / "outside.json"
            )
            traversal["output_paths"] = output_paths
            traversal_path = root / "traversal.invocation.json"
            traversal_path.write_text(json.dumps(traversal), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationError, "escapes"):
                load_invocation(traversal_path)

    def test_c19_sha256_hex_digest_format(self) -> None:

        ):
            _digest("g" * 64, "task_card.sha256")
        self.assertEqual("a" * 64, _digest("A" * 64, "task_card.sha256"))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            short = dict(raw)
            short["task_card"] = {

            uppercase["task_card"] = {
                **uppercase["task_card"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                "sha256": "A" * 64,
            }
            self.assertEqual(

    def test_c20_string_list_no_duplicates(self) -> None:

            # traversal guard lives in ``_safe_path``/``_load_canonical_invocation``
            # rather than in ``_validate_canonical_output_paths`` (which handles
            # pairwise uniqueness and reserved-artifact collisions only).

            output_paths["jsonl"] = str(
                root / "run" / ".agent-workspace" / ".." / "outside.json"
            )
            traversal["output_paths"] = output_paths
            traversal_path = root / "traversal.invocation.json"
            traversal_path.write_text(json.dumps(traversal), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationError, "escapes"):

    def test_c19_sha256_hex_digest_format(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
            InvocationValidationError, "SHA-256 hex digest"
        ):
            _digest("a" * 63, "task_card.sha256")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
            InvocationValidationError, "SHA-256 hex digest"
        ):
            _digest("g" * 64, "task_card.sha256")
        self.assertEqual("a" * 64, _digest("A" * 64, "task_card.sha256"))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            short = dict(raw)
            short["task_card"] = {
                **short["task_card"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                "sha256": "a" * 63,
            }
            with self.assertRaises(InvocationValidationError):
                parse_canonical_invocation(short)
            nonhex = dict(raw)
            nonhex["task_card"] = {
                **nonhex["task_card"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                "sha256": "g" * 64,
            }
            with self.assertRaises(InvocationValidationError):
                parse_canonical_invocation(nonhex)
            uppercase = dict(raw)
            uppercase["task_card"] = {
                **uppercase["task_card"],  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                "sha256": "A" * 64,
            }
            self.assertEqual(
                "a" * 64,
                parse_canonical_invocation(uppercase).task_card_sha256,
            )
            parsed = parse_canonical_invocation(raw)
            self.assertEqual(64, len(parsed.task_card_sha256))

    def test_c22_prior_canonical_acceptance_read_and_persist_byte_stable(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            start_path = root / "start.invocation.json"
            start_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
            invocation = load_invocation(start_path)
            status_path = invocation.status_path
            prior = {
                "schema": "orchestrator-lane-controller/v1",
                "state": "PROVIDER_EXITED",
                "invocation_schema": CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
                "worker_invocation_id": raw["worker_invocation_id"],
                "provider_id": "claude-code",
                "resume_identity": {
                    "task_card_id": "card-1",
                    "terminal_acceptance_state": "PENDING",
                },
            }
            status_path.write_text(json.dumps(prior), encoding="utf-8")
            found = _read_canonical_prior_status(invocation)
            self.assertIsNotNone(found)
            path, value = found
            self.assertEqual(status_path, path)
            self.assertEqual("PROVIDER_EXITED", value["state"])

            acceptance_identity = {
                "accepted_commit": "a" * 40,
                "accepted_by": "ROOT-IM",
            }
            updated = _persist_canonical_acceptance(
                status_path, value, acceptance_identity
            )
            self.assertEqual("ACCEPTED", updated["terminal_acceptance_state"])
            self.assertEqual("ACCEPTED", updated["task_advancement_state"])

            first_bytes = status_path.read_bytes()

            # identical bytes (deterministic sort_keys/indent serialization).
            again = _persist_canonical_acceptance(

    def test_c23_canonical_resume_admission_path_and_claims(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:

            start_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
            invocation = load_invocation(start_path)
            assert invocation.canonical is not None
            workspace = invocation.workspace
            self.assertEqual(
                workspace / "RESUME_ADMISSION.json",
                _canonical_resume_admission_path(invocation),
            )
            custom = replace(
                invocation,
                canonical=replace(
                    invocation.canonical,
                    resume_admission_path=Path("custom/RESUME_ADMISSION.json"),
                ),
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                workspace / "custom" / "RESUME_ADMISSION.json",
                _canonical_resume_admission_path(custom),
            )
            escaping = replace(
                invocation,
                canonical=replace(
                    invocation.canonical,
                    resume_admission_path=Path("..") / "escape.json",
                ),
            )
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(InvocationError, "escapes"):
                _canonical_resume_admission_path(escaping)

            # Valid claims accepted: top-level or nested resume_identity.

                "schema": "orchestrator-lane-controller/v1",
                "terminal_acceptance_state": "ACCEPTED",

            tampered = {
